quests.title: Inspiration Eruption

dialogue.t: This type of game sure is inspiring, hahaha!
Traveler! Good timing! I happen to need someone to playtest my new game.
Look here. I'm calling this game "Inspiration Eruption."
It perfectly captures the entire process of how we poets create poetry!

dialogue.sit: You mean drinking, drinking, and more drinking?
Before we write a poem, we have to start by seeking out inspiration.

dialogue.t: Hahaha, hilarious. Though using wine to let one's creative juices flow is certainly a good idea.
However, wine alone is not enough to inspire truly extraordinary poetry.
Before we write a poem, we have to start by seeking out inspiration.
Some like to travel, some prefer solitude, while others... really enjoy using wine to stimulate their creativity.
This is the most challenging part, since we cannot pinpoint where inspiration lies.
So most of the time we feel like we haven't found our muse, and become anxious and depressed...
But in truth, inspiration has already visited us and left its mark inside our heads without us ever knowing.
At the right juncture, they will come bursting out and take the form of a great poem... or a painting... or something else.

dialogue.sit: And you can turn all that into a game?

dialogue.t: Hahaha! Of course! The process of making poetry is quite clear and easily understood.
It just so happens that there are a few tabletop game designers in Mondstadt interested in my ideas.
After some discussions and a few brainstorming sessions, we finally came up with "Inspiration Eruption"!
You can try it right now if you're interested.
Play a few rounds, and maybe you'll become a poet yourself!

quests.description: Buies from Mondstadt seems to be thinking about something…
